Paintings · Texture · Stories

Forest & Flowers

A presence within the forest.

A hidden goddess emerges from leaves, vines, and flowers. Beside her, a pale river winds between densely textured mountains.

Mother Nature considers our dependence on the natural world—and the difference between appreciating nature and believing we control it.

The complete Forest & Flowers collection brings that attention to the natural world into ten paintings. Explore Forest & Flowers

Selected Collection

The Oceans

Shorelines, breaking waves, and the movement of water, expressed through sculptural texture.

About

Life isn’t 2D.Why should your art be?

Have a painting in mind, a question about the work, or an idea for something personal? I’d love to hear from you.

vudiphothisukart@gmail.com

The artist behind the work

Art, experienced.

To me, art is more than something to look at. It's something to experience — a conversation starter, a memory holder, and a way to bring life into a space.

I create mixed-media paintings that bring together sculptural texture, layered color, and organic forms. Through each collection, I explore the relationship between nature, form, and the world around us.

I want my work to invite people to pause, look closer, and discover something new each time.

Let's Talk Art.

For original artwork, commissions, collaborations, or exhibition opportunities, I'd love to hear from you.

vudiphothisukart@gmail.com
